source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: كنا رايحين رحلة، وفجأة السيارة وقفت بنص الطريق.
sentences.en: We were going on a trip, and suddenly the car stopped in the middle of the road.

sentences.ar: أبوي نزل وفتح غطا السيارة يتفرج.
sentences.en: My dad got out and opened the hood to look.

sentences.ar: قال إنه في مشكلة بالمي ولازم نستنى.
sentences.en: He said there was a problem with the water and we had to wait.

sentences.ar: الجو كان سخن والولاد بلشوا يزعلوا.
sentences.en: The weather was hot and the kids started to get upset.

sentences.ar: بعد شوي، وقف جنبنا رجال طيب بسيارته.
sentences.en: After a while, a kind man stopped next to us in his car.

sentences.ar: سأل شو المشكلة وحاول يساعد أبوي.
sentences.en: He asked what the problem was and tried to help my dad.

sentences.ar: جاب مي وصلح السيارة بربع ساعة.
sentences.en: He brought water and fixed the car in fifteen minutes.
We thanked him a lot and continued on our way.

sentences.ar: تعلمنا يومها إنه لازم نحمل مي زيادة.
sentences.en: That day we learned we should carry extra water.
